```renyi
public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let mutable lines: List of Text be []

  set lines to lines.append(render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths))

  let divider be
    for each width in widths
    collect "-".repeat(width)
  set lines to lines.append(render_row(cells: divider, widths: widths))

  for each row in table.rows
    set lines to lines.append(render_row(cells: row, widths: widths))
  end

  return lines.join("\n")
end
```

```renyi
public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """
```

```renyi
  let widths be for each width in column_widths(table) collect width.at_least(3)
  let header_line be render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths)

  let mutable separator_cells: List of Text be []
  for each width in widths
    set separator_cells to separator_cells.append("-".repeat(width))
  end
  let separator_line be render_row(cells: separator_cells, widths: widths)

  let mutable lines: List of Text be [header_line, separator_line]
  for each row in table.rows
    set lines to lines.append(render_row(cells: row, widths: widths))
  end

  return lines.join("\n")
end
```
